searchText: got a panda here head looks good merged, no trivial payloads and no forks we're finalizing people, I already have the u_justification for this epoch! congratulations to all Now that the merge has finalized, can we please agree to replace TTD with transition block number everywhere? it's simpler and TTD imo doesn't make much sense outside PoW Eventually I think we should do block number&hash. ACD party this morning? You got it! See you in ~40 minutes Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/616 Stream: https://youtu.be/DdUt77_eWyc Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91348592283?pwd=SnRnL1VTeXNYVE9CaWpBbnJEUXhQZz09 Is it only demand? base_fee is considerably higher than a few days ago. Since transactions now take longer to be included I wonder if this could mess slightly up this Or people now feel safer about using the network I think there has been a burst of activity following the merge, driving up the base fee. Heads up for folks not on ACD today - we agreed to pause calls after next week's CL call (Sept 22, 14:00 UTC) until ACD on Oct 27 (14:00 UTC), except if something urgent comes up. In the meantime, we'll try and make progress on discussing the technicals of Shangai EIP candidates async, and have optional #party-lounge hangs at our regular ACD/CL time weekly. I've drafted what this can look like here: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/shanghai-core-eip-consideration/10777 - will tweak it a bit in the next few days based on the conversations on the call today. We'll also have an EthMagicians session to discuss the roadmap with the community at devcon: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/ethereum-magicians-protocol-roadmap-gathering-devcon-vi/10866
